offers.sn: From Europe, for Europe – We are building Europe's Business AI. That's exactly why we developed amber: an AI-based platform that makes company knowledge accessible, supports internal workflows, and enables teams to work together smarter 📚
offers.rq: You bring additional language know-how in C/C++. Other languages such as Go, Rust, or JavaScript are nice to have and can be used flexibly depending on the use case You communicate confidently and reliably — in German and English — with various stakeholders You have the choice: Either a subsidized Deutschlandticket or an Urban Sports Club membership is on us
